rationale: Independent publicly released emperor-colony imagery observation histories can distinguish changing platform occupancy from simple published guano presence; first verify dataset structure before examining responses. Sea ice/shelf platforms are not physical rocky islands or inter-island natal settlement.
named_source: Macdonald et al. Observations Astrid, SANAE and Mertz emperor penguin colonies 1984-2024, Zenodo v3 10.5281/zenodo.17390368
prior_art: Macdonald et al 2026 Antarctic Science observed relocations and sea-ice trends 1984-2024
Macdonald et al 2026 Communications Earth & Environment tracked 3 different colonies from 2017-2024
Zitterbart et al 2014 Atka snow ramp and wind
Richter et al 2018 Atka colony motion and wind

source_gate.stage: only verify URLs, HTTP status, MD5, file formats, sheet names, first-sheet header text and known column-name eligibility; no outcome rows or tallies

proposed_later_estimands_if_preoutcome_e.unit: colony × austral breeding year with sufficient dated remotely sensed observations
proposed_later_estimands_if_preoutcome_e.response: first observed within-season platform transition, with explicit observational uncertainty and gap correction
proposed_later_estimands_if_preoutcome_e.exposure: independently timed wind/ice conditions and passability geometries observed BEFORE the transition
proposed_later_estimands_if_preoutcome_e.primary_competing: wind directional forcing versus physical platform-entry passability; independent ice stability and observation process
prohibitions: cannot infer entry passability from the transition itself
observed guano not necessarily live animals
do not claim natal-dispersal or settlement across physical islands
cannot use inferred ice platform as independent physical habitat predictor
proposed_later_estimands_if_preoutcome_e.novelty_warning: platform switches and wind are already published; no original discovery without independent predictor and held-out contrast

preoutcome_hard_stop: no unambiguous dated observation or platform headers
only a single event with no independent comparator
insufficient group tracking and image coverage
source DOI tracks cannot be retrieved and Zenodo histories lack the needed independent exposure
